messages.subject: how to visualize pairwise differences?
parts:
Hi all!

 

I've been thinking about how to visualize pairwise differences between groups using the "pairwise" function. I would greatly appreciate your opinion on using classical multidimensional scaling (MDS) with the Z matrix for this purpose.

 

Additionally, I'm not just interested in displaying a scatterplot; I would also like to include a "confidence interval" or another measure that clearly highlights the differences. Does anyone know of a method to achieve this? My initial thought is to utilize the distance matrix and its confidence intervals or iterations to accomplish this goal.

 

Thanks!

Juan

messages.author: fbfd20ce829c6c6c
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] how to visualize pairwise differences?
parts:
Hi Juan, 

Plotting group differences can be done in many ways including PCA and MDS. Each has different properties which correspond to different features of the data space. 

See plot.predict.lm.rrpp() and the examples for lm.rrpp(). You can perform PCA transformations and plot group ellipses with this function. 

Best,
Bryan
